description: Cancel the active plan now. What it added ends, including a paid period that has not started; that period and a purchase under 7 days are refunded. Requires accept_data_removal: true. Send `{ "accept_data_removal": true }`: what the plan added ends now (`account.cancel.losses` in `GET /api/plans` says what), including a period already paid that has not started yet, such as a renewal. A purchase made less than 7 days ago and a paid period that has not started go back the same way they were paid (card or Pix); USDC is refunded by the team.

accept_data_removal.description: Must be `true`: you accept losing what the plan added.

name: cancel_plan
title: Cancel plan
